Lorde posted a link on her website to an untitled project called 'XRAYS' on Fri, Jun 26 2026, It contains many various demos from Virgin. The project is 'private but shareable' and has all downloads disabled.

Surely untitled is secure enough that if downloads are strictly disabled, users are likely only going to hear a transcoded stream when playing and the original stream will be hard to download.. Right?
Well. maybe ask them, because the original metadata and "signed" wavs are pretty accessible. But its amazing for us Lorde stans
